source_location: p. 154, Results, subsection "Den sharing by ferrets"
verbatim_passage: Two of 41 excavated dens (rabbit burrows in nearly all cases) that were known to contain radio-collared ferrets were occupied by another ferret. The shared dens were excavated in May and August, and both were occupied by adult males.
verbatim_later_observation: Also, one of these males was relocated by radio telemetry three months later in November, and was occupying the same den as another radio-collared male.
